scoring_justification: Headline quantities are DFT barriers and free energies; full recompute in verifier is infeasible. Compare self-reported CSV values to paper golds within tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for DFT derived quantities (barrier and free energies)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text gives E_a (0.508 and 0.360 eV); ΔG_H2 and ΔG_H2O2 values are taken from free energy diagrams in Fig.5(c,d) and reproduced by the oracle solve.sh.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's results and encoded directly in solve.sh, which writes the expected CSV.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values directly traceable to published paper's numerical results.

outputs.description: DFT-computed water dissociation barrier and Gibbs free energy changes for H₂ and H₂O₂ evolution on pristine NaNbO₃ and V-doped NaNbO₃ surfaces.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker will compare the reported values to the paper's reported gold numbers with appropriate tolerances. The agent must compute all required values from scratch using a DFT implementation with the PBE functional.
